reading: The sketch lays out a CRM contact page: a top navbar, a left contact-info panel, a central activity feed, and a right column stacked with a deal-progress card, an open stage-dropdown menu, and a tasks/filter panel. Every box's exact contents and styling are spelled out in the typed notes attached to each stroke, which fully override the plain rectangle shapes shown.
